programme.title: Papi Gudia
programme.desc: A criminal uses a possessed doll to lure children and kill them. His latest target is Raju, the young brother of a dancer, who soon becomes the main suspect in a series of murders.

programme.title: Dhongee

programme.title: Pardesi
programme.desc: Myna rescues Ajay, who is bitten by a snake, but he loses his memory. He begins a new life with Myna and her family and the two fall in love, much to her secret lover's outrage.

programme.title: Mera Karam Mera Dharam

programme.title: Fifty Fifty

programme.title: Katilon Ke Kaatil
programme.desc: A wealthy widow meets Munna and Ajit and assumes them to be her estranged sons. She takes them into her house, unaware that their intentions are to loot her entire wealth.

programme.title: Rustum

programme.title: Yeh Hai Judgementâ€
programme.desc: Ashraf Ansari, a local resident of Mumbai, is taken into custody as a suspect for the bomb blast that shakes the entire city. He battles with the police and the corrupt system to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Asmaan Se Ooncha

programme.title: Dharmyudh
programme.desc: A successful man tries to reconnect with his old teacher only to find out that she is in deep trouble. Upon learning this, he decides to do everything he can to save her.

programme.title: Buniyad
programme.desc: he storyline involves a vengeful ex-convict who attempts to start a new life and deals with a "wicked woman" who tries to destroy the lives of those around him.

programme.title: Kundan
programme.desc: Shamsher Singh, who is involved in criminal activities, decides to get the better of Kundan, a police officer, after realising that he is a threat to him.

programme.title: Mera Faisla
programme.desc: Raj wishes to marry Rati but faces humiliation from her father due to the stigma associated with his lineage. Soon, he decides to join the police force to restore his family's honour.

programme.title: Naya Kadam
programme.desc: In a village ruled by Madhukar and Jaggu, who deprive the people of education so they can easily oppress them, Ramu manages to educate himself secretly with the help of a school teacher.

programme.title: Falak
programme.desc: Ramnath, a watchman, is killed while stopping his corrupt bosses from committing a crime. Years later, his sons decide to exact revenge against his murderers.

programme.title: Barah Aana

programme.desc: Hay Day. The crew have been working in the hot sun all day so Ree makes a classic dish. She cooks a cheesy casserole and spicy slow-cooked ribs. Plus, an ice cream cake for dessert. S12, Ep6

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Simple Meals. Ree is making meals from five ingredients. On the menu is chicken fennel bake, Teriyaki pork, creamy spaghetti carbonara and vegetable tortellini soup. S12, Ep7

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back To Basics
programme.desc: Classics Made Over. Ina Garten enjoys shaking up the classics! Her menu includes a new take on old-school lobster rolls and gives spaghetti carbonara a fresh, green update. S19, Ep7

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back To Basics
programme.desc: Good Cheese. Ina Garten shares incredible recipes starring her favourite cheeses. She makes fresh crab nachos, fresh fig ricotta cake and a panko-crusted rack of lamb. S19, Ep8

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Custard Week. The bakers put their twist on floating islands in the Signature, tackle a summer staple, and make custard the star of a showstopping set gateau. S13, Ep7

programme.title: Rachel Allen: Bake!
programme.desc: Rachel Allen: Bake! Rachel Allen showcases festive recipes that will impress Christmas guests. She creates a fun gingerbread house and teaches her students how to make perfect mince pies. S1, Ep17

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: Sarah Raven. Gardener Sarah Raven cooks up a stunning dish in Prue's kitchen. Plus, there's a fool proof hack for making a perfect vinaigrette salad dressing. S1, Ep9

programme.title: New: 100 Cooks
programme.desc: 65 Cooks To Go. Eighteen of the remaining 65 home cooks take on a bake sale, a takeout battle, and a steak dinner. Eight cooks will be headed home. S1, Ep3

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Keepin' It Real. In Miami, Guy visits the Asian fusion spot giving Brussels sprouts a makeover. In Eureka, CA, a soul food spot serves up favourites like jerk fried chicken. S19, Ep4

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Dynamite Duos. Guy Fieri checks out spots keeping it in the family. In New York, a sibling spot pickles, smokes, cures and ferments everything from goat necks to pig ears. S19, Ep5

programme.desc: Cat Scratch Fever: From a cat with a cold to a new mother with kittens, the team also encounter a dog that's eating golf balls, goat kids in distress and a cow with milk fever. (S9, ep 15)

programme.title: Exotic Animal ER
programme.desc: Snake Me Home Tonight: Bindi the snake might have burn wounds, Pebbles the chinchilla has a crusty nose and Holly Pepper Potts the pig throws a temper tantrum. 7+ (S6, ep 4)

programme.title: Monster Fish
programme.desc: Giant Killer Catfish: Zeb travels to Albi in France where he discovers that huge catfish are feasting on pigeons. But can he catch one for himself? 7+ (S7, ep 3)

programme.title: Fish Tank Kings
programme.desc: Fish Upon A Star: It's sink-or-swim time as the team build a $40,000 aquarium for a live coral reef. It would be one of the biggest tanks in the US, but can they pull it off? 7+ (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo: North Carolina
programme.desc: Dr Zoo-Little: At the North Carolina Zoo, a gorilla has emergency surgery, vets examine a deadly rattlesnake and zoo keepers try to take blood from a lion. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Greek Islands From Above
programme.desc: Greek Islands: Uncover the beauty of the Santorini skyline, Corfu's Venetian fortress and a summer festival with a fiery twist on the island of Spetses. (2 of 6) 7+

programme.title: Shells: Shaped By Nature
programme.desc: Shells: Shaped by Oceans: Discover the hidden world of shells, where beauty meets survival in nature's intricate designs across Africa's ancient marine realms. 7+ (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Fish Tank Kings
programme.desc: There's A Tree In My Tank!: The team take on the task of recreating an African lake. As well as being filled with cichlids, the tank must also feature a sausage tree. 7+ (S2, ep 7)

programme.title: Pond Stars
programme.desc: School Of Rock: New guy Chris feels the pressure when he is challenged to transform a back garden. Despite nerves and setbacks, can he put what he's learned into practice? (S1, ep 2) 7+

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: Silly Filly: The team treat a bull's limp, a cat's oozing lump, a musk ox's walking difficulties and a horse whose strong-willed filly is causing trouble. (S11, ep 17) 7+

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: Right in the Sniffer: The team treat a dog with nose bleeds, Woody Island's new calves, a gagging cat and an aging bald eagle. Dr Oakley is roped into a cowboy competition. (S11, ep 18) 7+

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo: Tampa
programme.desc: Rhino Dynamo: The staff at Zoo Tampa help expand the pygmy hippo population, while rehabilitating an injured manatee and releasing it back into the wild. (S4, ep 4)

programme.title: Predator In Paradise
programme.desc: In the Shallows: Beaches provide the backdrop for epic battles for survival. Just of shore, the shallows are full of life, but everything is fighting to stay alive. 7+ (1 of 3)

programme.title: Predator In Paradise
programme.desc: Seaside Assasins: Serene beaches provide the backdrop for epic predator battles as coastal creatures go head to head in a ferocious fight for survival. 7+ (2 of 3)

programme.title: Border Protection Spain
programme.desc: Land, Sea & Air Surveillance: Drug traffickers lead the Coastguards on a high-speed chase, an illegal fishing boat invades a nature reserve and a dinghy sends out a distress call. 7+

programme.title: Ultimate Airport Dubai
programme.desc: Go behind the scenes at one of the world's busiest airports. Staff are forced to deal with tens of angry passengers delayed by bad weather. (S3, ep 2) 7+

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Chatroom Japan
programme.desc: David Bull came to Japan to master the art of woodblock printing - he learned valuable lessons about Japanese culture and that there is more to the works of art than the paper they are printed on.

programme.title: Impacts: Climates Change the World
programme.desc: Data centres, the engines of our digital age, consume vast energy and drive a surge in CO2 emissions that intensify climate risks while powering global connectivity.

programme.title: Design Museum Japan
programme.desc: Miyamae Yoshiyuki (Fashion designer) visits Kochi. Kochi's Sunday market features around 500 stalls with fixed locations. Miyamae contemplates how communication has contributed to its longevity.

programme.title: The Factory Wonders
programme.desc: The team explores a factory in Saitama making globes for educational use and much more besides. See the skill it takes to turn flat maps into spherical globes - and what in the world is an 'AR globe'?

programme.title: Time-Lapse Japan
programme.desc: The world's thinnest washi (traditional paper) is just 0.03 mm thick but tough, and is used to restore cultural artifacts. See Tosa's natural landscape and washi artisans at work, in time-lapse.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: The Seasons of Yamato
programme.desc: A series of poetic videos by Koichi Hozan, a videographer living in Nara, in collaboration with pianist Mine Kawakami - for which she plays exclusive pieces - helps you experience each season.

programme.title: Bosai: Science That Can Save Your Life
programme.desc: Japan has a long history of natural disasters - 'Bosai' explores how to overcome them and save lives with the power of science.

programme.title: Magical Japanese
programme.desc: The Japanese language is rich in words and expressions influenced by nature, history, and culture - this episode looks at words related to hair. Explore the unique culture behind them.

programme.title: Easy Japanese
programme.desc: #26 This Japanese omelette is sweet and delicious. / Stack adjectives to get more ways to express your impressions. The key is changing the first 'I' of 'I'-ending adjectives to 'kute'.

programme.title: Culture Crossroads
programme.desc: Every summer, several typhoons approach Japan and make landfall. By understanding the way they move and the power of their rainstorms, we can learn how to protect ourselves and our possessions.

programme.title: Hello! NHK World-Japan
programme.desc: At the University of Tokyo's Study Abroad Fair, NHK World-Japan showed students how its content can be used to learn practical English, and introduced an educational program in Japanese schools.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Seasoning the Seasons
programme.desc: This programme visits places across Japan to introduce the charms of their local daily life and festivals fostered by the nation's long history.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
